# Controlled original-ID word composition

SOURCE ONLY, UNCOMPILED/UNEXECUTED. This is a private library composition of
the existing conditional-word provider, not a native launch, new dispatch
operation or proof that a supplied word is a physical calendar.

## Input, representation and result

`controlled_word(request,mask,limits)` accepts the unchanged
`source_word::Request` with Natural initialization and one Option<bool> per
ORIGINAL hybrid registry entry. The input retains the full original graph,
sample/global-label embedding, hybrid modes, interval slots, operation word,
terminal choice and inherited provider budgets. The private result fields
expose read-only original-request/mask references, the unchanged ordered
slot/population/gamma bank, full selected views with literal range witnesses,
and composition work. These references associate declared Rust objects;
captured-byte origin and executable authentication remain separate.

For each natural original-register assignment z, the composition constructs
the existing canonical initial Snapshot and its ORIGINAL natural weight I(z;g).
It invokes the unchanged `source_word::word_row` with Conditional initialization.
At forced nodes it changes the child mode to Independent, then substitutes
only the conditional TRANSITION polynomial T:

    output(b) = sum_z I(z;g) * substitute_mask(T(controlled_modes,z,b))

Here g=P(true/parent1). Some(false) substitutes0 and Some(true) substitutes1
in transition gamma coordinates. Natural weights I are outside substitution.
Unforced COMMON reads the SAME stored register; forced nodes use the original
current-owner independent endpoint kernel. Empty current-owner sets retain
their original deterministic empty assignment.

Every complete selected view keeps ordered genealogy, original population
and the full vertex register. Its witness is rechecked against that view.
The composition groups only equal complete selected values; it does not erase
registers or observations, deduplicate affine constraints, alter Farkas
multipliers, create control sites or charge private coordinates as observations.
The completed-row option reuses the existing ancestral-completion path.
The final exact polynomial sum must equal1. Any child refusal or composition
limit aborts the entire result; no partial Table or source exclusion is returned.

## Profile limits and writer boundary

The inherited profile still has at most four sampled copies,32 full-bank
coordinates,32 word letters,16 interval slots and256 slot/gamma variables.
Over-profile requests return a named unavailable/UNKNOWN disposition; no
truncation or mathematical all-source NO occurs. Original initialization
assignment/term limits still apply before enumeration. Complete supplied
letters are source-validated before soft composition limits; the original
child validator runs again on every call. This source mirror is not a
parser/validator proof.

Composition counters bound conditional requests, cumulative observed child
work, polynomial work and retained output. Child work is observed AFTER each
bounded child result, and the inherited provider budgets apply inside it.
This is not transitive allocator/process/resource enforcement. Existing
Polynomial multiplication is reused; its temporary rational and map
allocations are not a global memory-cap proof. The real controller must own
resource bounds, encrypted UNKNOWN/recovery and every transitive first writer.

No compiler, Cargo/Lake/native/CI/QE/model or new emitter/control run has
occurred. The actual original-owner encrypted controller/recipient/frame/
sequence/transport and transitive writer hooks remain UNBOUND. All held and
consumed jobs, old plaintext-record qualifications and canonical profiles
remain unchanged. There is no runtime launcher or admission override here.
